title: The quadratic formula
alt: x = (-b plus or minus the square root of b squared minus 4ac) over 2a, written in white chalk on a slate board

title: An aligned derivation
alt: f(x) = the integral from 0 to x of dt over 1 plus t squared, on the next row = arctan x, aligned on the equals signs, in white chalk on a slate board

title: A matrix product, in yellow chalk
alt: A two by two matrix a b c d times the column x y equals the column ax + by, cx + dy, in yellow chalk on a slate board
latex: \begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix} x \\ y \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} ax+by \\ cx+dy \end{pmatrix}

title: Chalk alone, with no board
alt: The curl of E equals minus the partial derivative of B over the partial derivative of t, in yellow chalk on a transparent page, shown here on a dark background
